prompt:

Header text verbatim: "internationell". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "international".

Memory-link caption verbatim: "internationell resembles international.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon arbetar i en internationell organisation.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
